metadata.scope: Declared US-style Algebra 1 reference profile with on-demand numerical foundations and optional Algebra 2/course-dependent extensions.
metadata.coverage_claim: A complete authored map for the explicitly declared reference profile. Standards crosswalks are scoped author judgments, not certification, local-school approval or empirically calibrated placement.
not_claimed: Durable mastery from a short streak
A production scoring API or working graph interface

reference_profile.name: Algebra 1 reference profile
basis: CCSS high-school content references with explicit course-scope restrictions
Illustrative Mathematics Algebra 1 as a published scope comparator
reference_profile.course_allocation_status: AUTHOR_DESIGNED; school and jurisdiction allocations vary
reference_profile.foundation_policy: Assess on demand from target evidence. Foundation nodes are not a compulsory opening course.
reference_profile.extension_policy: Optional nodes and optional conditional variants do not block core completion.

requirements: Evidence covering the declared core outcomes and required variants.
Constructed performance and applicable explanation/representation criteria.
Unit-level transfer evidence and recorded unresolved boundaries.
An explicit later-review policy before using a durable-mastery label.
completion_policy.no_shortcut: A standard tag, a correct anchor or a single numerical answer cannot independently complete a skill or course.

mathematical_practices.policy: Integrate all eight CCSS mathematical practices; do not use practice labels as substitute evidence.

item_requirements: Accepted item and applicable checking result
No item-specific hint or revealed solution
Required structural/representational variation appropriate to the node
POLICY-IMMEDIATE-3.retention: Record separately from a later event
POLICY-IMMEDIATE-3.invalid_item_effect: Remove from success/failure counts and re-evaluate dependent claims

diagnostic.classification: An answer is observed evidence; a cause is a bounded hypothesis.
diagnostic.single_probe_limit: A correct probe means the earlier error was not reproduced, not that a slip is proven.
diagnostic.repeated_error_limit: Repeated errors support a pattern but do not uniquely establish an internal mechanism.

representation.policy: Graph or drawing tasks require actual supported representations or teacher review; text-only numeric substitutes do not count as graphical performance.

statistics.quartiles: Median of lower/upper halves; exclude the overall median when n is odd unless the item declares another convention.
statistics.standard_deviation: Population SD for core examples unless explicitly labeled otherwise.
statistics.technology: Regression, correlation, SD and graph construction may require declared tools.
statistics.correlation: Association is not causation and r is not a percent-correct score.

overlap.policy: One item has one primary skill. Secondary tags may describe components, but do not automatically promote related core/extension nodes.
